eventDetail.scope: The Second International Conference of Data Analytics for Sustainability and Engineering Technology (DASET) aims to bring together researchers, practitioners, and experts from academia and   industry to discuss and exchange cutting-edge research and innovations in the fields of data analytics, sustainability, and engineering technology. The conference seeks to explore the applications of data analytics in promoting sustainability across various domains and leveraging engineering technology to address global challenges
